caption: The video showcases a light wooden stick laid horizontally across a gray sheet on a white surface, with a row of cylindrical magnets in front and a row of flat magnets behind it. In the first frames, two hands grip the ends of the stick, holding it steady over the magnets. The view changes to a top-down shot where the stick remains across the magnet rows without hands. A single hand enters from the left, holding a small polished steel ball. The hand places the ball on the left end of the stick and adjusts its position. The hand opens and withdraws, leaving the ball resting near the stick’s left end. The ball then travels rapidly to the right along the stick, appearing blurred as it moves between the two magnet rows. It comes to rest near the right end, with only small shifts afterward.
relations: Two hands grip the stick ends over the magnet rows; releasing them leaves the stick spanning the gray sheet.
A hand places a steel ball on the stick's left end between the magnet rows.
The ball travels rightward along the stick, blurring as it moves between the magnet rows.
The ball comes to rest near the stick's right end with only small shifts afterward.
